title: Lead AI Security Automation Engineer — Agentic AI & LLM Platforms — Full-Time, US
description:
Full-time hire | Hybrid or remote within the United States, depending on location | $160,000–$215,000 USD annual base salary plus bonus

We're hiring a hands-on lead engineer to build and lead a team of AI automation engineers for cybersecurity operations. Despite the title, this is not a security-assessment or standards role. We want an application/software engineer with strong AI/ML skills who embeds AI into workflows to speed up business processes. Security knowledge is a plus, not a requirement.

The work

- Build and lead a team of AI automation engineers for cybersecurity operations.
- Architect and personally build agentic AI platforms: agents, memory, guardrails and tool orchestration.
- Build RAG and retrieval systems: embeddings, semantic search and prompt management.
- Engineer cloud-native AI solutions on AWS, Azure or GCP using containers, serverless and event-driven designs.
- Build APIs that connect AI capabilities to security tools and platforms.
- Set up evaluation, testing and observability frameworks for AI quality and behavior.
- Mentor engineers and drive architecture decisions.

What we're looking for

- 10+ years of software engineering, including 4+ years building AI/ML/GenAI solutions.
- Proven production experience with agentic workflows and LLM-based systems.
- Strength in distributed systems and async, event-driven architecture.
- Python, JS/TS, Rust, Go, Bash and PowerShell.
- CI/CD experience (Jenkins, Argo CD, Spinnaker or similar).
- Master's degree preferred (CS, software engineering, AI, data science, cybersecurity or related).

Nice to have

- LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain or Semantic Kernel.
- Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Kafka or Airflow.
- Vector databases and enterprise RAG platforms.
- MLOps/LLMOps and AI governance or risk management.
- Cybersecurity domain knowledge (threat detection, SOC, threat hunting). Helpful, not required.

To apply

Briefly share the closest agentic AI or LLM system you personally built and shipped to production: what it did, your part, the stack, the scale, and the team you led. Links or anonymized examples are welcome. Tell us your availability for a full-time role, your US location, and whether the annual salary range fits. Short, specific proposals are welcome.

title: Senior Generative AI / Agentic AI Engineer — LLM, RAG, LangGraph, Python
description:
21IDEAS LLC is expanding our AI engineering team in preparation for upcoming client projects.

We are looking for multiple experienced Senior Generative AI / Agentic AI Engineers who are interested in working with us on upcoming long-term AI projects.

We expect new client opportunities soon and want to build relationships with strong engineers in advance so we can move quickly when projects begin.

Ideal experience includes:

* 5+ years of professional software engineering / AI experience
* Strong Python development
* Generative AI and Large Language Models
* Agentic AI and AI agent development
* RAG and vector databases
* LangChain and/or LangGraph
* Prompt engineering
* REST APIs and tool/function calling
* MCP experience is a plus
* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud AI experience
* Production deployment, monitoring, security, and scalability
* Strong spoken English and ability to participate in technical discussions

When applying, please include:

1. Your current resume
2. Total years of professional experience
3. Years of hands-on Generative AI / LLM experience
4. Your strongest AI/LLM technologies
5. Your hourly rate
6. Your availability
7. A brief description of a production AI/LLM system you personally built

This posting is for upcoming opportunities and does not guarantee immediate project work. Selected engineers will be contacted as suitable projects become available.

We are interested in building long-term working relationships with strong AI engineers, not filling only a single position.
